notes.title: Steam Leaderboards and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Steam Leaderboards. 

I have added Steam Leaderboards to the game so now you show off your times/Wins to the reset of the world.
Which means all your local scores are gone, Sorry! 

Times / Wins board now has 3 buttons Global / Friends / Your Position. Only for the currently selected level.

Lobby mini games

Added another shooter mini game. (All scores are also Global only shows the top 10.)

Added both mini Shooters to the singleplayer lobby.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40466570/9d7d209bf0bacb882523f14cbaf6a60427273b2f.png


New Player Characters

Added lots of new player Characters to choose from.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40466570/b54a0acd7268cfa5779e16de22686698eaab3059.png

BUG FIXES


 SteamVR Will no longer start up if you are not playing in VR.

 Valve grip's have been adjusted so they dont drop Items Randomly (Untested at this moment. I dont own a Vive).

 Grip Distance for non-VR Players has been increased.

notes.title: 0.0.3.21 Non-VR Update, Tanks, Spaceships and Much More.
notes.notes:
Here is a Massive update for version 0.0.3.21

The game has had a massive overhaul with a new player system, Animations, Sounds and Effects. 

First lets start with the fixes.

FIXES


 Lighting on some of the levels.
 AI going though the islands on Spainish invasion.
 Extras cannons no longer fire if you dont have them.
 Laser grid start time.
 Player scores are stored for a short time if you lose connection or quit.
 No more flying everywhere when you get hit due to a new hit system.
 Added a glowing orb above player ships in Space invasion (Wave mode)
 Much more I'd be here all day listing them. ːsteamhappyː


Gardor - The great Icewall has been redesigned.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40466570/0b81837b2fe1154aaedbd8e460b34031d91f460c.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40466570/415103e1f18f3d325202c48a8d09242f2f103c4b.png

Ok now for the good stuff.

NEW

NON-VR

You can now play with Non-VR players, they do have limits. ie - Can only carry 1 weapon, also cant throw the swords or shields. Climbing can be difficult (but all part of the fun).

Every Gamemode is playable in Non-VR using either a controller or keyboard and mouse. (No keybinding yet but will be added in the future.)

Non-VR player hud.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40466570/c711d11ff632a6043a15d1097635cdb5bf12da88.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40466570/5290a4634124ab5bbc1af4ac7d8351f056568c7c.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40466570/f80ed9bf513ddd1a95dcc6dc0db86c9ac0761468.png


PLAYER MODELS

New player models have been added to make customizing your character easier. (Will more than likely be changed again, as those are assets from the store and everyone seems to use them.)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40466570/f3858b4dc54f8de09791b4a9030edfdaf4d86127.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40466570/fd2820b13b7aa09187811b1a2003642ef35f28d4.png

Player Animations well makes sense now that you have legs and arms. (Still need's work in places.)

New player hands (just 100X better than the old ones.) (No gestures other than pointing but more will be added.)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40466570/0deee57f2bb85596e07b380bb2b099f694c0bb84.png


MAIN MENU AND LOBBIES

Lobbies and Main Screen has been redesigned.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40466570/1a51c8779f987b60231accf333c0ee4fb2faf747.png

Done a whole redesign of the main menu which has the character shop, level shop and customizing the player. Yes you can customise your character in the lobbies aswell.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40466570/8d8381ba6de7b6e3faa7c71adf78ce49b7980807.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40466570/dfad8b6d925a113634e47122c3b9ddea4a70bd38.png

Added a quick join button so you can get straight to the action. Or if no games are found will create a Quick match lobby where voting is key.

Added a Mini-game to the lobbies while you wait for other players or beat the Hosts score. Even a piano so the VR players can play you some songs while you wait.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40466570/ccf22183e04b8278cdfc9813ecc9552a828e7d5a.png

CHALLENGES

Challenges have been added to the main menu with challenges that last a day, a week or a month. All with Rewards once completed. (More will be added. ideas?)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40466570/b6fdc99574f1a9ea47719ed7dd0b8a55f7beb10c.png

GAMEMODES

Tanks - Fight in armoured combat on the new large scale map Farmland. Found in battleships gamemode.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40466570/7455822694b6feb7f0795e63cf85daf784eb3723.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40466570/1d474c4b32e9e27d119a74ebd6e73330490b5a8a.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40466570/e267733a12f5bd771859987388456e07008fab93.png

Spaceships - Fly around the new map Asteroids while trying to destroy the other players. Also found in battleships gamemode. (Very fast movment).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40466570/3070538e9f5d065567cbd48ef2d29e94e52eadf9.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40466570/246b54da5f780170a05f37b274ed0eac7f37f982.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40466570/3f1d952c3edac0a249ce6b27432f0982c24306b4.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40466570/a64a8b7df66c223471984b0fb1b19f597d371f9b.png

Rumble / Rumble Squads - Players now drop items on death. (Health / Ammo  refill  etc) (maybe even weapons??)

New Map - WarZone
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40466570/d1d04a1c2f535461919a7ece701ac97df6d0e9de.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40466570/1eeec992ef8ab34ba5769f10bd961e27191b93ca.png

Waves - Few tweaks some nice surprise's for you to discover.

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
0.0.315 Bug Fixes (Hot Fixes)

Few bug people have noticed I have fixed,


The Player no longer sees their own spawn protection.
Climbing on Treasure Island.
Cave is lighter on Monkey Business.
Removed invisible wall that stopped you from getting to the Monkey bars. (Monkey Business)
Added a pipe barrier to split the different sections. (Monkey Business)
Removed Punch from the Lobby.
Fixed Money / level and best times Reset.
You no longer will get stuck in the corner on breach.
Fix a load screen Glitch.
